description: Crossref metadata deposition for hosted works is discontinuous after 2024; some posted works and reviews are not registered or are registered late.
effect_on_counts: Undercount of hosted works and of reviewed hosted works from 2024 onward; series flagged partial_coverage.
handling: Counted as observed; coverage_matrix marks affected years partial_coverage; no imputation.

description: Registration of Crossref peer-review records for works hosted outside 10.32388 largely ceased after 2022.
evidence: Crossref peer-review records under 10.32388 with external is-review-of targets (observed per run)
effect_on_counts: Later years understate reviewing activity of external works; row status dormant, partial_coverage.
handling: Counted as observed; limitation stated; no imputation.

description: No DOI-level review records exist in Crossref or Sciety for MedEd Publish; public reviews are visible only on the platform site.
evidence: Crossref peer-review query under 10.15694 and 10.12688/mep (observed per run)
effect_on_counts: A reviewed-works series cannot be reconstructed; only posted works are counted.
handling: Row counts posted works (version-1 or base records); limitation stated.

description: Sciety ingests PREreview evaluations from the group's joining date; earlier PREreview activity is not in the docmaps.
effect_on_counts: Undercount in the earliest years of the series.
handling: Series starts at coverage_start_year; earlier years marked no_data, never zero.

description: Sciety ingests preLights highlights from the group's joining date; earlier highlights are not in the docmaps.
effect_on_counts: Undercount in the earliest years of the series.
handling: Series starts at coverage_start_year; earlier years marked no_data, never zero.

description: Some Crossref peer-review records carry placeholder or malformed is-review-of targets (empty, self-referencing or non-DOI identifiers).
effect_on_counts: Reviews without a resolvable target cannot qualify a work; affected works are undercounted.
handling: Relation retained with target_flag; excluded from eligibility; reported here with counts.

description: Metadata may be first registered (created) or redeposited (deposited) after the analysis cutoff while the event date lies before it.
effect_on_counts: Historical series may change between retrievals; counts are reconstructed event history, not cutoff-date observability.
handling: Included when the event date is on or before the cutoff; events_registered_after_cutoff_counted and events_redeposited_after_cutoff_counted reported.

description: Peer Community In recommendation DOIs are dated by the recommendation, not by the preprint posting; Crossref issued dates may be year-precise for early recommendations.
effect_on_counts: Counting year follows the recommendation date; year-precision dates overlapping the cutoff are not counted.
handling: Earliest qualifying evaluation rule; ambiguous_cutoff_date applied where relevant.

description: Crossref issued, posted, created, deposited and indexed carry different meanings; Sciety evaluation dates are evaluation publication dates.
effect_on_counts: Mixing date fields would shift events between years.
handling: Event-date priority table applied; created/deposited/indexed kept as diagnostics only.

description: EGUsphere preprints without any of the three attribution signals remain unattributed.
effect_on_counts: Attributed series is a yearly lower bound.
handling: Keep interim rows with included=false and no_journal_attribution; coverage_matrix records partial_known_scope.

description: Sciety group responses may contain a different publisher account.
evidence: publisher validation at the normalisation boundary; D-034
effect_on_counts: The affected normalisation fails and produces no output.
handling: Hard-fail on every mismatching or absent publisher account; never discard mismatches silently.

description: Re-registered primary records under 10.1108/EOR-* carry the issued date of the last original version, not of the first public posting. Confirmed for one work: v1 10.12688/emeraldopenres.13140.1 issued 2019-06-07; v2 10.35241/emeraldopenres.13140.2 is aliased to 10.1108/eor-03-2023-0005, issued 2019-12-09. Titles carry no version tag, so the number of multi-version works cannot be determined from the permitted sources.
effect_on_counts: A work whose original versions span two calendar years is counted in the later year; the row total is unaffected. Direction: later. Magnitude: unknown, bounded by the share of multi-version works.
handling: The counting event is the earliest issued date among the work's retrieved records (§5.1); primaries with no other retrievable record are counted at their own issued date. The 10.12688 v1 record is retained as the counting record of its work, the primary carrying record_flag later_version; correspondence_basis version_stem+alias+relation. Pairs of 10.1108 records that share a title but have no machine-readable link are counted as distinct works and listed here as unresolved.

description: Emerald Open Research review reports were withdrawn at source: the review handles now alias the article's own primary DOI and no peer-review record exists in Crossref or DataCite.
evidence: Handle 10.21956/emeraldopenres.14208.r26506 carries HS_ALIAS to 10.1108/EOR-03-2023-0005 (set 2025-11-19); Crossref REST 404; filter issn:2631-3952,type:peer-review = 0; DataCite 404; 0 emeraldopenres stems among the 10.21956 peer-review records (observed per run)
effect_on_counts: none on work counts; evaluation counts for the row are absent, not zero
handling: Row counts first public posting (D-044); has-review is never resolved through the alias because that would equate an evaluation id with a work id (D-046); limitation stated beside MedEd Publish.

description: JMIRx Med deposits no Crossref peer-review records; review reports and author responses are journal-article records in the same container.
evidence: filter prefix:10.2196,type:peer-review = 0; 316 'Peer Review of …' and 104 'Authors' Response to Peer Reviews of …' among 622 journal-article records under ISSN 2563-6316 (2026-10-27)
effect_on_counts: companion items excluded from the work count (exclusion_reason companion_item); evaluation counts absent, not zero
handling: companion_title_regex marks the companion items at extraction (D-050); they stay in the interim with included=false and are not attributed to articles (no is-review-of relation).

description: Some MedEdPublish review and article DOIs were deposited with a repeated slash (10.21956//mep.…, 10.15694//mep.…).
effect_on_counts: none once collapsed; a strict string match would lose the 2021 work and its three reviews
handling: Raw strings kept (doi_original, target_id_raw, source_record_id); canonical identifiers collapse // to / ; identifier_flag=repeated_slash on the records and relation lines (D-053).

description: Thirteen journal-article records under the community stem d28e8e57 (evaluation summaries and manager reports) carry no relation at all; ISSN 3071-2173 is absent from every record of the stem, including the title-level record.
evidence: filter prefix:10.21428 stem d28e8e57 on 2026-10-31: 106 records = 42 peer-review, 49 component, 13 journal-article, 1 posted-content, 1 journal (title-level record 10.21428/d28e8e57, outside every walk); 42 peer-review with is-review-of to 36 distinct external targets; counter-example 10.21428/d28e8e57.ad95c497 (relation empty); unjournal_probe_2026-10-31.json
effect_on_counts: none on works; evaluation count per work is a lower bound
handling: not in scope; evaluation summaries deposited as journal-article without is-review-of; request sent to the service 2026-10-31

description: The Crossref issued date of a Review Commons report is the publication date of the report package at transfer to a journal (mandatory since 2022-06-01), not the date of review.
effect_on_counts: Counting year follows the package publication date, which lags review and may cluster on posting days; the row total is unaffected.
handling: Earliest qualifying evaluation rule on issued (D-065); no date is imputed.
